components.name: stack
components.useWhen: Vertical rhythm for forms, article blocks, settings panels, and repeated content.
components.avoidWhen: Items should align in rows or have equal card-like weight.

components.name: grid
components.useWhen: Equal-weight repeated items, catalogs, metrics, and cards.
components.avoidWhen: The layout needs a clear main/support relationship.

components.name: sidebar
components.useWhen: Filters, navigation, metadata, or settings beside a main task.
components.avoidWhen: Both columns have equal importance; use wa-split instead.

components.name: editorial
components.useWhen: Asymmetric magazine-like rhythm for hero, article intro, or narrative pages.
components.avoidWhen: Dense operational screens that need predictable scanning.

components.name: button
components.useWhen: Clickable command or link action.
components.avoidWhen: The element is navigation-only text; use normal links inside nav/list.

components.name: card
components.useWhen: A bounded idea needs its own surface.
components.avoidWhen: Wrapping entire page sections or nesting multiple cards.

components.name: form
components.useWhen: Stacking labeled inputs and actions.
components.avoidWhen: Controls are only filters beside a data table; consider wa-sidebar plus compact density.

components.name: table
accessibility: Wrap in wa-table-wrap for horizontal overflow.
components.useWhen: Dense comparable records.
components.avoidWhen: Data is a small set of KPIs; use wa-stat or chart display.

components.name: donut
accessibility: Add visible value text or aria-label.
components.useWhen: Simple percentage display.
components.avoidWhen: Users need interactive chart analysis.

components.name: progress
accessibility: Pair with a text value or aria-label.
components.useWhen: Linear completion or capacity value.
components.avoidWhen: Multiple comparable categories need labels; use table or bar chart.

components.name: meter
accessibility: Pair with a score label or aria-label.
components.useWhen: Risk, health, quality, or score indicator.
components.avoidWhen: Value has no meaningful low-to-high scale.

components.name: tabs
accessibility: Application code must manage aria-selected, keyboard focus, and panel visibility.
components.useWhen: Switching between related panels.
components.avoidWhen: All content should be visible for scanning.

components.name: modal
accessibility: Application code must provide role, aria-modal, focus trap, Escape close, inert background, and restore focus.
components.useWhen: Blocking confirmation or focused task.
components.avoidWhen: A normal page section or inline alert is enough.

components.name: japanese-helpers
components.useWhen: Adding meaningful paper, seal, crest, layered, or vertical Japanese tone.
components.avoidWhen: Decorating every component without hierarchy.

components.name: extended-inputs
accessibility: Use native inputs inside these wrappers.
components.useWhen: Forms need binary choices, search, grouped fields, range values, or uploads.
components.avoidWhen: A plain wa-input or wa-select is enough.

components.name: selection-controls
accessibility: Application code must manage selection state and keyboard interaction.
components.useWhen: Users need filtering, command selection, segmented modes, or editable tags.
components.avoidWhen: A native select is sufficient.

components.name: extended-feedback
accessibility: Use live regions in app code for dynamic updates.
components.useWhen: Pages need persistent notices, inline health, loading states, or result screens.
components.avoidWhen: A simple inline validation error is enough.

components.name: extended-data
accessibility: Provide text values for visual indicators.
Use tables for dense comparable data.
components.useWhen: Operational screens need KPIs, metadata, compact lists, calendars, or simple trend visuals.
components.avoidWhen: Users need full chart interaction.

components.name: app-navigation
components.useWhen: Building admin, SaaS, or documentation shells.
components.avoidWhen: The page is a simple editorial document.

components.name: overlay-surfaces
accessibility: Application code must handle positioning, focus, dismissal, and keyboard behavior.
components.useWhen: A page needs layered detail, contextual help, menus, or mobile sheet surfaces.
components.avoidWhen: Inline content is clearer.

components.name: work-screen-patterns
components.useWhen: Building repeated operational workflows with actions, lists, details, and settings.
components.avoidWhen: A content page only needs section and stack rhythm.

components.name: japanese-concept-surfaces
components.useWhen: A brand or editorial surface needs stronger Japanese visual identity.
components.avoidWhen: The UI is dense and repeated, where decoration would reduce scanning.
